title: New Justin Jefferson Jettas Mix Cereal 2025 Limited-Edition Minnesota Vikings
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:Football-NFL
descriptionText: The product is a limited-edition cereal featuring Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson, part of the "Jettas Mix" line by General Mills. This collectible item pays homage to the player and his team, making it a must-have for fans of the Minnesota Vikings and football enthusiasts alike. With a black color scheme and a focus on the NFL league and regular season, this unique cereal blends sports and entertainment for a special 2025 release.
